name: get_briefing
description: Return the spoken briefing for the current incident: what broke, the error summary, and the most recent config change.

name: query_logs
description: Summarize recent errors in the checkout service logs: total count and the top error.

name: what_changed
description: Report the most recent configuration change to the checkout service: old value, new value, time, and who made it.

name: ask_runbook
description: Answer a question from the runbook for this alarm.

question.description: The engineer's question, in their words.

name: execute_remediation
description: Run an approved fix. The only allowed action is revert_fail_mode. Set confirmed to true only after the engineer has said the word confirm in their latest turn. The server verifies this against the call transcript and refuses otherwise.

action.description: Allowlisted action name. Only revert_fail_mode is allowed.

confirmed.description: True only if the engineer said confirm in their latest turn.
